+// attempts to /api/relay. A backoff, not a tight loop: the gateway being
+// down must not spin the laptop awake.
+const remoteRelayReconnectWait = 5 * time.Second

 func remoteBrowserVerifier(key string) (string, error) {
 	proof, err := remoteBrowserProof(key)
 	if err != nil {
 		return "", err
 	}
 	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(proof))
 	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
 }
+
+// remoteAEAD builds the session's AES-GCM cipher from the link key.
+func remoteAEAD(key string) (cipher.AEAD, []byte, error) {
+	aeadKey, nonceBase, err := remoteSessionKey(key)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, err
+	}
+	block, err := aes.NewCipher(aeadKey)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, err
+	}
+	aead, err := cipher.NewGCM(block)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, err
+	}
+	return aead, nonceBase, nil
+}
+
+// remoteSeal encrypts one relay payload for the terminal -> browser
+// direction. Nonce = 4 zero bytes (direction tag) || 8-byte big-endian
+// counter; the browser uses the same construction under tag 1, so the two
+// counters never collide and no state is shared between the ends.
+func remoteSeal(aead cipher.AEAD, nonceBase []byte, toBrowser bool, n uint64, plaintext []byte) ([]byte, error) {
+	nonce := remoteNonce(nonceBase, toBrowser, n)
+	return aead.Seal(nil, nonce, plaintext, nil)
+}
+
+// remoteOpen decrypts one relay payload from the browser's direction.
+func remoteOpen(aead cipher.AEAD, nonceBase []byte, n uint64, ciphertext []byte) ([]byte, error) {
+	return aead.Open(nil, remoteNonce(nonceBase, false, n), ciphertext, nil)
+}
+
+// remoteNonce builds one frame's nonce: the HKDF base with the direction in
+// the first byte and the counter in the last eight.
+func remoteNonce(base []byte, toBrowser bool, n uint64) []byte {
+	nonce := make([]byte, 12)
+	copy(nonce, base)
+	if toBrowser {
+		nonce[0] |= 0x01
+	}
+	binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(nonce[4:], n)
+	return nonce
+}
+
+// remoteRelayWire is one frame as it crosses the relay socket: the gateway
+// forwards it verbatim, payload opaque.
+type remoteRelayWire struct {
+	Kind    string          `json:"kind"`
+	Payload json.RawMessage `json:"payload"`
+}
+
+// RemoteRelayClient is the terminal side of the relay: it dials /api/relay
+// with the link's id and the browser verifier, and trades encrypted frames
+// with whatever browser holds the link's key. Events go out (Subscribe), a
+// browser's turns come back (SetTurns). Reconnects forever at a calm
+// interval; the session on the gateway survives a laptop asleep, the
+// sweeper retires only what stays empty for 12h.
+type RemoteRelayClient struct {
+	link   remoteLink
+	token  string
+	events <-chan gateway.AgentEvent
+	turns  chan remoteRelayTurn
+	closed chan struct{}
+	once   sync.Once
+}
+
+// NewRemoteRelayClient starts the terminal side for one conversation's link.
+// events is the TUI's agent-event feed (the websocket adapter's — the same
+// events the screen shows); a channel the caller closes ends the client.
+func NewRemoteRelayClient(link remoteLink, token string, events <-chan gateway.AgentEvent) *RemoteRelayClient {
+	rc := &RemoteRelayClient{
+		link:   link,
+		token:  token,
+		events: events,
+		turns:  make(chan remoteRelayTurn, 8),
+		closed: make(chan struct{}),
+	}
+	go rc.run()
+	return rc
+}
+
+// Turns is where a browser's turns arrive; read it in a goroutine of the
+// caller (the TUI posts each as a chat turn through the poster).
+func (rc *RemoteRelayClient) Turns() <-chan remoteRelayTurn { return rc.turns }
+
+// Close stops the client: no reconnect, no more turns.
+func (rc *RemoteRelayClient) Close() { rc.once.Do(func() { close(rc.closed) }) }
+
+// run connects, pumps events, and reconnects until closed.
+func (rc *RemoteRelayClient) run() {
+	for {
+		select {
+		case <-rc.closed:
+			return
+		default:
+		}
+		if err := rc.connect(); err != nil {
+			select {
+			case <-rc.closed:
+				return
+			case <-time.After(remoteRelayReconnectWait):
+			}
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// connect dials one relay session and pumps until the socket breaks.
+func (rc *RemoteRelayClient) connect() error {
+	verifier, err := remoteBrowserVerifier(rc.link.Key)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	wsURL := strings.Replace(remoteSiteBase, "https://", "wss://", 1)
+	wsURL = strings.Replace(wsURL, "http://", "ws://", 1)
+	// A local gateway (the usual dev case) is reached directly, not through
+	// the public site: the relay lives on whatever served the TUI.
+	if base := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(gatewayAddr, "/"), ""); gatewayAddr != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(gatewayAddr, "https://memdoor.ai") {
+		u, perr := url.Parse(gatewayAddr)
+		if perr == nil && u.Host != "" {
+			wsURL = "ws://" + u.Host
+			if strings.HasPrefix(gatewayAddr, "https://") {
+				wsURL = "wss://" + u.Host
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	q := url.Values{}
+	q.Set("id", rc.link.ID)
+	q.Set("verifier", verifier)
+	q.Set("token", rc.token)
+	conn, _, err := websocket.DefaultDialer.Dial(wsURL+"/api/relay?"+q.Encode(), nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	defer conn.Close()
+
+	aead, nonceBase, err := remoteAEAD(rc.link.Key)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	// Read side: decrypt browser frames, deliver their turns.
+	go func() {
+		var n uint64
+		for {
+			_, raw, err := conn.ReadMessage()
+			if err != nil {
+				return
+			}
+			var wire remoteRelayWire
+			if json.Unmarshal(raw, &wire) != nil || wire.Kind != "turn" || len(wire.Payload) == 0 {
+				continue
+			}
+			clear, err := remoteOpen(aead, nonceBase, n, wire.Payload)
+			if err != nil {
+				continue // wrong key, replay, or garbage: drop the frame
+			}
+			n++
+			var turn remoteRelayTurn
+			if json.Unmarshal(clear, &turn) == nil {
+				select {
+				case rc.turns <- turn:
+				case <-rc.closed:
+					return
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}()
+
+	// Write side: seal each agent event as a frame.
+	seq := uint64(time.Now().UnixNano()) // a random-ish start: nonces must never repeat across runs
+	for {
+		select {
+		case <-rc.closed:
+			return nil
+		case ev, ok := <-rc.events:
+			if !ok {
+				return nil
+			}
+			body, err := json.Marshal(remoteRelayFrameData{
+				RunID:     ev.RunID,
+				SessionID: ev.SessionID,
+				Seq:       ev.Seq,
+				Stream:    string(ev.Stream),
+				Data:      ev.Data,
+				Timestamp: ev.Timestamp,
+			})
+			if err != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			payload, err := remoteSeal(aead, nonceBase, true, seq, body)
+			if err != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			seq++
+			raw, err := json.Marshal(remoteRelayWire{Kind: "event", Payload: payload})
+			if err != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			_ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
+			if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, raw); err != nil {
+				return err // socket broke: reconnect and keep streaming
+			}
+		}
+	}
+}
